purpose: Immutable self-scoped idempotency receipt for the B01 CreateActivity operation, binding one operation identifier and intent fingerprint to exactly one canonical Activity identity.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated self Person that scopes the operation identifier.
columns.value_contract: Existing Person NativeRef; operation ids are not globally reusable across self-Person scopes.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.meaning: Caller-supplied idempotency identity for one CreateActivity attempt stream.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed, non-empty, at most 200 characters; same scope+id may replay only the same immutable intent fingerprint.

columns.name: intent_fingerprint
columns.meaning: Canonical lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 fingerprint of the normalized CreateActivity intent.
columns.value_contract: Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Same operation id with a different fingerprint is a conflict, not a replay.

columns.name: activity_ref
columns.meaning: The one canonical Activity NativeRef created or replayed for this operation identity.
columns.value_contract: References one existing Activity and is unique across operation receipts.

columns.name: created_at
columns.value_contract: Recorded by the bounded PostgreSQL CreateActivity capability in the same transaction as canonical creation.

primary_key.name: pk_activity_create_operation
primary_key.reason: The self-Person scope plus operation identifier is the database arbiter for CreateActivity idempotency.

foreign_keys.name: fk_activity_create_operation_self_person_ref_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Idempotency is scoped to an existing authenticated self Person without turning the technical receipt into a Domain identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_activity_create_operation_activity_ref_activity
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: A successful operation receipt resolves to exactly one existing Activity identity and never acts as that identity itself.

unique_constraints.name: uq_activity_create_operation_activity_ref
unique_constraints.reason: Prevent multiple operation receipts from claiming creation ownership of the same Activity identity.

check_constraints.name: ck_activity_create_operation_operation_id
check_constraints.reason: Require one bounded normalized operation identity.

check_constraints.name: ck_activity_create_operation_fingerprint
check_constraints.reason: Require the exact canonical SHA-256 hexadecimal fingerprint representation used by CreateActivity replay comparison.

indexes.name: pk_activity_create_operation
indexes.reason: Indexed database idempotency arbiter for self-scoped operation lookup and locking.

indexes.name: uq_activity_create_operation_activity_ref
indexes.reason: One-to-one receipt ownership of the created Activity identity.

state_history.current_binding: The receipt is immutable technical control state and does not participate in Domain MaterialState current bindings.
state_history.chronology: created_at records receipt establishment; the operation id and UUIDv7 values are not chronology substitutes.
state_history.immutability_policy: The complete receipt is immutable after insert. Replay compares the stored fingerprint; no runtime UPDATE surface exists.

lifecycle.retention: Retained while needed to preserve safe CreateActivity replay semantics for canonical Activity creation.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE. B01 downgrade removes receipts only when no canonical activity_intention rows exist; otherwise downgrade fails closed.

obligations: same self-Person operation id plus same normalized intent replays the original Activity
same self-Person operation id plus different intent is rejected as conflict
runtime has no generic table DML or direct receipt-read authority
one Activity identity cannot be claimed by multiple create-operation receipts
